entities.title: Games
entities.summary: The six games, one folder each, sharing no code at build time.
entities.purpose: Groups the games: Rally (rally/), Shatterbelt (shatterbelt/), Hivestorm (hivestorm/), Samosa (dictator/) and Gambit (chess/), each an npm project and a Cloudflare Worker, and LodeStar (lodestar/), a Rust and Godot desktop game. Each game's folder is worked in on its own, with its own install and tests.
boundaries: A game with a package.json is tested on every pull request that changes it and deployed when that change reaches main (.github/scripts/changed-games.sh); LodeStar has none, so the workflows leave it out.
Rally, Shatterbelt and Hivestorm carry identical copies of src/online.ts, and Rally copies Samosa's name rules; the copies are tracked as debt in games/rally/src/.dev/backlog.json.
